meta.what: MCP tools/list, every MCP feature flag UNSET
meta.source: openai-resubmission working tree, all MCP flags unset

tools.name: create_order
tools.title: Create order
tools.description: Create a new NivaDesk order in the currently connected workspace. Use the connected workspace automatically. Do not ask for companyId. If the user provides a delivery due date, always pass it as deliveryDueDate in YYYY-MM-DD format. For an already overdue active order, also collect and pass its original created date as paymentDate so Timeline & Delivery and overdue calculations remain accurate. Use this only after the user provides enough order details or confirms creating a draft order.

companyId.description: Workspace/company ID where the order should be created.

watchModel.description: Watch model or reference, for example Rolex Datejust 41.

designBrief.description: Short design brief or customer request.

paidAmount.description: Already paid amount, for example deposit amount.

paymentDate.description: Order created/intake date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required when creating an already overdue active order.

deliveryDueDate.description: Preferred delivery due date field in YYYY-MM-DD format. Always pass this field when the user provides a delivery date.

dueDate.description: Legacy alias for deliveryDueDate in YYYY-MM-DD format. Prefer deliveryDueDate.

deliveryDays.description: Alternative only when no calendar due date was provided: number of days from created date until due.

tools.name: search_orders
tools.title: Search orders
tools.description: Search orders in the currently connected workspace by customer name, email, watch model, status, order ID, or keyword. Use the connected workspace automatically. Do not ask for companyId.

query.description: Search keyword, customer name, email, watch model, or order ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to return. Default is 10.

tools.name: get_order_detail
tools.title: Get order detail
tools.description: Get full safe order details for one order in the currently connected workspace. Use the connected workspace automatically. Do not ask for companyId.

tools.name: add_order_note
tools.title: Add order note
tools.description: Append an internal note to an existing order in the currently connected workspace. This is an order note, not a personal Notes item. Do not ask for companyId.

tools.name: update_order_status
tools.title: Update order status
tools.description: Update an order status or design status in the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId. Use only when the user clearly asks to update the order.

tools.name: create_note
tools.title: Create personal note
tools.description: Create a new personal Notes item for the connected user in the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId. This is not an order note. Collaboration is not changed automatically.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

tools.name: search_notes
tools.title: Search personal notes
tools.description: Search the connected user's personal Notes in the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

query.description: Keyword to search in title, text, labels or note ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return. Default is 20.

tools.name: get_note_detail
tools.title: Get personal note detail
tools.description: Get one personal note by note ID from the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

tools.name: append_note
tools.title: Append to personal note
tools.description: Append text to an existing personal note for the connected user in the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId. This is not an order note.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

text.description: Text to append to the note.

tools.name: update_note
tools.title: Update personal note
tools.description: Update the title, text, labels, links or color of a personal note in the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

tools.name: pin_note
tools.title: Pin or unpin personal note
tools.description: Pin or unpin a personal note in the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

isPinned.description: True to pin, false to unpin.

tools.name: archive_note
tools.title: Archive or unarchive personal note
tools.description: Archive or unarchive a personal note in the currently connected workspace. Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

isArchived.description: True to archive, false to unarchive.

tools.name: get_order_financials
tools.title: Get order financials
tools.description: Read the Financial Info card values for one order. You may provide the orderId, or provide query/orderName/customerName so NivaDesk finds the order in the connected workspace. Do not ask the user for companyId. Requires financial access.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

orderId.description: Optional order document ID when already known.

query.description: Order name, customer name or identifying keyword when orderId is not known, for example Ocean Scene Dial.

orderName.description: Optional order/project name alias when orderId is not known.

customerName.description: Optional customer name when orderId is not known.

tools.name: get_dashboard_summary
tools.title: Get dashboard summary
tools.description: Read the connected workspace dashboard summary. ChatGPT App is available on every plan. Free Demo and Starter return permitted basic finance totals (Received, Base Cost and Basic Balance); Pro and Team can return advanced finance when the user role allows it.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to scan. Default is 500.

tools.name: get_extra_spending_overview
tools.title: Get extra spending overview
tools.description: Read permitted spending summary data for the connected workspace. Free Demo and Starter return Base Cost only. Pro and Team may include Shipping, Platform Fee, VAT / Tax and custom expenses when the user role allows financial access. Supports thisMonth, thisYear, allTime and customRange.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

scope.description: Optional period: thisMonth, thisYear, allTime, or customRange. Default is thisMonth.

fromDate.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required only when scope is customRange.

toDate.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required only when scope is customRange.

includeBaseCost.description: Include Base Cost / watch purchase price. Default true.

includeTax.description: Include VAT / tax amount. Default false.

page.description: Page number for entry results. Default 1.

tools.name: get_financial_overview
tools.title: Get financial overview
tools.description: Read workspace-level financial totals, remaining payments, costs and estimated profit. Requires financial access in the connected workspace.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

limit.description: Maximum number of orders to scan. Default is 1000.

tools.name: get_bank_spending_summary
tools.title: Bank spending summary
tools.description: Summarise the connected workspace's business bank feed (Open Banking) for a month or a year: total spent, incoming, change vs the previous period, spending by category, top merchants and recurring subscriptions. Use for questions like 'how much did I spend in July', 'what are my biggest costs this year', 'which subscriptions do I pay monthly'. Requires the Bank Spending permission (workspace owner or a member the owner granted). Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

year.description: Four-digit year. Defaults to the current year.

month.description: 1-12. Defaults to the current month when period is month.

tools.name: search_bank_transactions
tools.title: Search bank transactions
tools.description: List individual bank transactions from the connected workspace's bank feed, filtered by keyword (merchant/description), date range, category, amount range, or missing receipt. Returns the newest first. Requires the Bank Spending permission. Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

query.description: Keyword matched against merchant and description, e.g. amazon, openai.

category.description: Category name as shown in NivaDesk, e.g. Materials, Software, Shipping; use Uncategorised for transactions without a category.

direction.description: out = spending (default), in = incoming, all = both.

withoutReceipt.description: true = only spending that has no receipt/invoice attached yet.

tools.name: attach_bank_receipt
tools.title: Attach receipt to a bank transaction
tools.description: Attach an invoice/receipt the user shared in the chat to the matching bank transaction in NivaDesk. Pass the user's file as `receipt`. NivaDesk OCRs images itself; for PDFs (or to help matching) also pass the total amount, the document date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the merchant name you read from the document. If NivaDesk finds one confident match it attaches the file immediately; if several transactions could match it returns candidates with an inboxPath — show them to the user, then call again with the chosen transactionId and the same inboxPath (no need to resend the file). Workspace owner only. Do not ask for companyId.

companyId.description: Optional. Usually omit this; the connected workspace is used automatically.

receipt.description: The invoice/receipt file the user attached (image or PDF).

inboxPath.description: Returned by a previous call when several candidates matched; pass it back together with transactionId instead of resending the file.

transactionId.description: Bank transaction to attach to, when the user has chosen one of the candidates (or named the transaction).

amount.description: Total amount printed on the document, if you can read it.

date.description: Document/payment date YYYY-MM-DD, if you can read it.

merchant.description: Merchant/supplier name on the document, if you can read it.
